history.gap: One-dimensional negotiations: single-scalar fee + wage spinboxes; no installments, sell-on clauses, loans, contract length or bonuses — the core of FM's deal-structuring loop is absent.

No transfer windows or deadline day: the market runs uniformly all year with no time pressure, no rival competition for targets, and no end-of-window drama — the emotional core of FM's Transfer Centre is missing.

No recruitment pipeline around the deal engine: FM24's hub PUSHES targets at you — shortlists, scout recommendation queues, agent-offered players, transfer rumours, DoF delegation — while this screen is entirely pull-based: a flat 268-row search table and two dual-role coach-scouts, no shortlist, no rumour mill, no scout hiring/network, so between deals the centre is inert.

Market scale starves the scouting game: one 16-club league with ~266 scoutable targets, where a single scout takes a top target from a masked P$254K-742K range to 100% knowledge and a full report in ~10 days — the discovery/uncertainty engine that makes FM24's global, effectively inexhaustible scouting hub a season-long strategic layer collapses into a two-week checklist here.

history.note: Discovery-economy gap verified closed by an independent critic driver: 694-target universe (366 club / 80 FA / 248 prospects; 426 external), 6-stage knowledge ladder with truth-containing bands that narrow ([24,25,13,10,4,0] -> exact), travel really gates flow (5 zero-gain transit days to the islands), focus sweeps hard-capped at 60%, hiring bounded at 4 dedicated scouts; one scout deep-covers 0.4% in 60 days, a MAX-staffed 6-judge department only 3.7% in 90 days; assignments incl. travel_left survive save/load. Residual FM24 edges (raw database scale, data-hub/statistical scouting channel, free existence-enumeration in Search) noted but not area-losing.

fix_note: Wave2 round3 fix: rebuilt the discovery ECONOMY. (1) Scoutable universe 266 -> 694: two overseas leagues (Sevii Island League + Orange Archipelago League, 16 virtual clubs, transfer-eligible/no loans) and 7 regional prospect pools, all regenerated deterministically from career_seed with only departures persisted (ext_removed delta) so saves stay light. (2) Knowledge is STAGED and costly: 6-stage ladder (Untracked/Rumour/Initial/Part scouted/Detailed/Full) with per-stage unlocks (moves at 50, IVs+exact at 100), daily knowledge accrual by scout JA x region familiarity, interim reports at 50% with star-rating UNCERTAINTY BANDS that narrow (banded pros/cons, no leaks), full book ~10-25 days per target. (3) Throughput throttled: scouts have physical locations, cross-region travel 2d / overseas 5d before any knowledge flows, focus sweeps hard-capped at 60% (3 targets/day) so depth demands dedicated watches, overseas-native hire-market scouts unlock the islands. Proof: coverage_driver.tscn simulates 60 days with one scout auto-reassigned - 3/694 = 0.4% deep coverage, stage histograms printed at day 15/30/45/60, determinism + save/load byte-true.
